title: smriti event reader + cursor persistence
description:
## Parent

sutra/1 — prd for sutra watcher daemon

## What to build

New module that opens smriti's `index.db` read-only (SQLite WAL allows concurrent readers) and wraps the `events_since` query. Handles cursor persistence: read/write `~/.sutra/smriti_cursor` (single i64 file). Detects cursor invalidation (smriti pruned events past cursor) and returns a \"full reparse needed\" signal.

Config: `SUTRA_SMRITI_DB` env var defaulting to `~/.smriti/index.db`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New module opens smriti DB read-only and queries events_since
- [ ] Cursor persisted to `~/.sutra/smriti_cursor`, read on startup
- [ ] Missing cursor file starts from 0
- [ ] Cursor invalidation detected and signaled (cursor_valid: false)
- [ ] `SUTRA_SMRITI_DB` env var with `~/.smriti/index.db` default
- [ ] Unit tests with a synthetic smriti DB: normal pagination, cursor invalidation, empty table

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately."
